cc:Work.dc:title: Simplicity
cc:Work.dc:description: Canonical compiler module source and assembled native profiles are shown in separate panels on zero-based axes; they are different counting boundaries and are never connected. Canonical physical lines reach 34231; assembled native profiles reach 39545. Historical physical, nonblank and noncomment code lines remain separate series with missing observations left unplotted. The public CLI uses 152 Bend lines, 246 OS-provider C lines and 19 startup C lines. Source size is a proxy, not a complete measure of simplicity.

g.text: Simplicity · keep the counting boundaries visible
Compiler features and native support grew the maintained source.
ASSEMBLED NATIVE PROFILES · separate counting boundary
Includes generated / bundled material and the selected entry point.
The public CLI is 152 Bend lines; its OS provider and startup add 246 + 19 C lines.
Removing runtime interpreter dependencies is a simplicity gain; total source size did not shrink.
